Guam was represented at the [[2008 Summer Olympics]] in [[Beijing]], China by the [[Guam National Olympic Committee]].

In total, six athletes including four men and two women represented Guam in five different sports including athletics, canoeing, judo, swimming and wrestling.

==Competitors==
In total, six athletes represented Guam at the [[2008 Summer Olympics]] in [[Beijing]], China across five different sports.<ref name="guam">{{cite web |title=Guam at the 2008 Summer Olympics |url=https://www.olympedia.org/countries/GUM/editions/53 |publisher=Olympedia |access-date=28 June 2025}}</ref>

==Athletics==
{{main|Athletics at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

In total, two Guamanian athletes participated in the athletics events – [[Derek Mandell]] in the [[Athletics at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's 800 metres|men's 800 m]] and [[Cora Alicto]] in the [[Athletics at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Women's 100 metres|women's 100 m]].<ref name="guam"/>

Mandell trained for the Olympics by running for about 40 minutes in the morning, lifting weights, and running in the ocean for extra resistance.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QLvcLRNkx_s |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211221/QLvcLRNkx_s |archive-date=2021-12-21 |url-status=live|title=Beijing Bound: Derek Mandell|date=8 August 2008 |publisher=pncsports}}{{cbignore}}</ref>

The heats for the men's 800 m took place on 20 August 2008. Mandell finished eighth in his heat in a time of one minute 57.48 seconds and he did not advance to the semi-finals.<ref>{{cite web |title=2008 Summer Olympics, 800 metres, Men |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/257197 |publisher=Olympedia |access-date=28 June 2025}}</ref>

The heats for the women's 100 m took place on 16 August 2008. Alicto finished seventh in her heat in a time of 13.31 seconds and she did not advance to the quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite web |title=2008 Summer Olympics, 100 metres, Women |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/257553 |publisher=Olympedia |access-date=28 June 2025}}</ref>

==Canoeing==
{{main|Canoeing at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

In total, one Guamanian athlete participated in the canoeing events – [[Sean Pangelinan]] in the [[Canoeing at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's C-1 500 metres|men's C-1 500 m]] and the [[Canoeing at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's C-1 1000 metres|men's C-1 1,000 m]].<ref name="guam"/>

The heats for the men's C-1 500 m took place on 19 August 2008. Pangelinan finished seventh in his heat in a time of two minutes 12.696 seconds and he advanced to the semi-finals. The semi-finals took place on 21 August 2008. Pangelinan finished ninth in his semi-final in a time of two minutes 17.94 seconds and he did not advance to the final.<ref>{{cite web |title=2008 Summer Olympics, Canadian Singles, 500 metres, Men |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/258784 |publisher=Olympedia |access-date=28 June 2025}}</ref>

The heats for the men's C-1 1,000 m took place on 18 August 2008. Pangelinan finished eighth in his heat in a time of four minutes 49.284 seconds and he did not advance to the semi-final.<ref>{{cite web |title=2008 Summer Olympics, Canadian Singles, 1,000 metres, Men |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/258793 |publisher=Olympedia |access-date=28 June 2025}}</ref>

==Judo==
{{main|Judo at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

In total, one Guamanian athlete participated in the judo events – [[Ricardo Blas Jr.]] in the [[Judo at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's +100 kg|men's +100 kg]] category.<ref name="guam"/>

==Swimming==
{{main|Swimming at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

In total, one Guamanian athlete participated in the swimming events – [[Christopher Duenas]] in the [[Swimming at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's 100 metre freestyle|men's 100 m freestyle]].<ref name="guam"/>

The heats for the men's 100 m freestyle took place on 12 August 2008. Duenas finished seventh in his heat in a time of 52.64 seconds which was ultimately not fast enough to advance to the semi-finals.<ref>{{cite web |title=2008 Summer Olympics, 100 metres Freestyle, Men |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/261487 |publisher=Olympedia |access-date=28 June 2025}}</ref>

==Wrestling==
{{main|Wrestling at the 2008 Summer Olympics}}

In total, one Guamanian athlete participated in the wrestling events – [[Maria Dunn (wrestler)|Maria Dunn]] in the [[Wrestling at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Women's freestyle 63 kg|women's freestyle −63 kg]] category.<ref name="guam"/>

The women's freestyle −63 kg category took place on 17 August 2008. Dunn received a bye in the first round. In the second round, she lost to [[Elina Vaseva]] of Bulgaria.<ref>{{cite web |title=2008 Summer Olympics, Middleweight, Freestyle (≤63 kilograms), Women |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/263525 |publisher=Olympedia |access-date=28 June 2025}}</ref>
